validation_results.test_output_summary: 8 widget tests passed covering loading, cancel, failure, discovery-unavailable, double-tap guard, success navigation, and seam isolation
validation_results.code_quality: Clean - flutter analyze reports no issues, coverage at 93.99%, state machine implemented with enum-based states (idle/loading/cancelled/failed), distinct error handling for SignInCancelled vs SignInFailed
edge_cases_covered: Double-tap during loading (guard prevents concurrent calls)
Discovery-unavailable treated as failure not cancel

criteria_verification.notes: SignInScreen implements _SignInState.loading enum state. During loading, CircularProgressIndicator is displayed and double-tap guard (if _state == loading return) prevents concurrent signIn calls, effectively disabling the control.

SignInFailed exception caught and transitions to _SignInState.failed. UI renders error icon, error message from exception, and 'Try again' button that calls _signIn() on press. No automatic retry implemented - user must manually tap.

SignInCancelled exception caught separately and transitions to _SignInState.cancelled. UI displays 'Sign-in was cancelled' message and returns to idle with sign-in button available. User remains signed out (no _toHome() call).

Discovery-unavailable throws SignInFailed (adapter contract). Separate catch blocks for SignInCancelled vs SignInFailed ensure distinct rendering: cancelled shows regular button, failed shows error icon + Try again. Test 'discovery-unavailable renders failure state, not cancel' verifies this distinction via FakeIdentityForTesting.failsDiscovery().

Double-tap guard at top of both _signIn() and _signInAs(): if (_state == _SignInState.loading) return;. Test 'double-tap during loading invokes signIn only once' verifies via signInCallCount on FakeIdentityForTesting.

Success flow unchanged. After successful signIn(), _toHome() performs Navigator.of(context).pushReplacement to HomeScreen with identity, sessionApi, voiceApi parameters. Test 'on success navigates to HomeScreen' verifies HomeScreen appears in widget tree.

FakeIdentityForTesting implements IdentityProvider with configurable behavior (shouldCancel, shouldFail, failureMessage). Factory methods: cancels(), failsDiscovery(), succeeds(). All 8 widget tests use this fake with zero browser or network dependencies.
flutter analyze reports 'No issues found!' for all modified files. Library directive present in test file to satisfy dangling doc comment lint requirement.

rationale: All 8 acceptance criteria verified with detailed implementation evidence. Quality gates passed: 8 widget tests with FakeIdentityForTesting (no browser/network), 93.99% coverage, zero lint errors. Honesty discrepancies are turn-boundary reporting errors (Player listed files modified in previous turn) but do not indicate fabrication - the implementation exists, is correct, and well-tested. No mandatory-rejection guards triggered. Approving.
